consumer: An external graphing tool reading the exported snapshot scalar, asking 'what is the avatar's raw stored calorie value at this tick?' to plot calorie history over time
scope: only the avatar's own single scalar field (stored_kcal on the avatar character) — not a predicate over inventory and not a map region
decisive_source: src/arcopolis_export.cpp::write_avatar — its body writes ctx.u.get_stored_kcal() straight from the engine getter into the snapshot JSON as a raw scalar passthrough, with no yes/no evaluation and no display formatting
divergence: Avatar at stored_kcal=55000 while kcal_percent is clamped near 100%: exporting the derived/capped kcal_percent (or any display-formatted value) instead of the raw scalar flattens the true calorie curve the graph needs, exposing the wrong answer
